instruments_timeframes: Source does not impose a universal market/timeframe; use chart-selected symbol and timeframe unless the script inputs specify otherwise.
indicators: Inputs (source declarations): openRange = input.float(0.4, "Open Range %", step=0.1, group="=============== Indicator Settings ==============="); startH = input.int(9, "Start Hour", inline='start', group="========= Start Trade AT ========="); startM = input.int(15, "Start Minute", inline='start', group="========= Start Trade AT ========="); stopNewTrade = input.int(14, "Stop Hour", inline='start', group="========= Stop New Trade At ========="); endH = input.int(15, "End Hour", inline='end', group="========= Close All Trade At ========="); endM = input.int(0, "End Minute", inline='end', group="========= Close All Trade At ========="); isCloseAll = input.bool(true, "Close All Trade", group="========= Close All Trade At ========="); isHighV = input.bool(true, "Show High", inline="range", group="========= Plot Range ========="); isLowV = input.bool(true, "Show Low", inline="range", group="========= Plot Range ========="); buffer = input.float(0.0, "Buffer", group="========= Strategy Settings ========="); tradeGap = input.float(100, "Trade Gap", group="========= Strategy Settings ========="); gapBook = input.float(50, "Min Profit Point After Trade Gap", group="========= Strategy Settings ========="); longMsg = input.string("Long", "Long MSG", group = alertGroup); shortMsg = input.string("Short", "Short SMG", group = alertGroup); longExitMsg = input.string("Long Exit", "Long Exit SMG", group = alertGroup); shortExitMsg = input.string("Short Exit", "Short Exit MSG", group = alertGroup); tradeMode = input.string("Percent", "Trade Mode", options=["Point", "Percent"], group="========= Strategy Settings ========="); sl = input.float(1, "Stop Loss Point Or Percent", group="========= Strategy Settings =========")
entry_long: Source rule: longCondition with all conditions true validOpen
entry_short: Source rule: shortCondition with all conditions true validOpen
exit: Source rule: strategy.position_size  exceeds  0; order: strategy.exit("Long Exit", "Long", stop=longSL, limit= longTarget, comment_loss="Long SL", comment_profit="Long Profit", alert_message=longExitMsg); Source rule: strategy.position_size  is below  0; order: strategy.exit("Short Exit", "Short", stop=shortSL, limit= shortTarget, comment_loss="Short SL", comment_profit="Short Profit", alert_message=shortExitMsg)
stop_loss: strategy.exit("Long Exit", "Long", stop=longSL, limit= longTarget, comment_loss="Long SL", comment_profit="Long Profit", alert_message=longExitMsg); strategy.exit("Short Exit", "Short", stop=shortSL, limit= shortTarget, comment_loss="Short SL", comment_profit="Short Profit", alert_message=shortExitMsg)
take_profit: strategy.exit("Long Exit", "Long", stop=longSL, limit= longTarget, comment_loss="Long SL", comment_profit="Long Profit", alert_message=longExitMsg); strategy.exit("Short Exit", "Short", stop=shortSL, limit= shortTarget, comment_loss="Short SL", comment_profit="Short Profit", alert_message=shortExitMsg)
position_sizing: Source strategy() declaration determines defaults when present; no exchange risk budget is inferred. See source for qty/default_qty_type/default_qty_value.
filters: Only conditions present in the cited source are represented in entry rules; no external filters added.
implementation_notes: Paraphrased from the cited Pine source file. Third-party Pine source; verify execution timing, pyramiding, and broker-emulator semantics before implementation.
